judgment.reasoning_summary: The polynomial P(x) is a geometric series with a common ratio of x. The divisor x^2 - 5x + 6 factors into (x - 2)(x - 3). For P(x) to be divisible by x^2 - 5x + 6, it must be divisible by both (x - 2) and (x - 3). This means P(2) = 0 and P(3) = 0. Solving these equations gives n = 1.
